title: first100-acceptance-coverage
description: Maintainer decision BLOCKED-004 predicate (i) data source (2026-09-01). A Supervisor-curated, append-only index mapping each registry epic's acceptance[] entry to the named command-freeze.json expectCases title(s) that actually exercise it -- command-freeze.json entries carry no acceptance-index metadata of their own (B4(c)'s '1:1 mapping' intent was never captured structurally at freeze time), so this artifact reconstructs it honestly, once per epic, cross-checked mechanically against command-freeze.json's real frozen entries and their real (later, ledger-recorded) observed-passing titles. Never a free-text or Writer-supplied claim: every citation must resolve to a real frozen (and, for the coverage-closure predicate, a real observed-passing) case.

acceptanceIndex.description: 0-based index into the registry epic's acceptance[] array.

supplementSeq.description: Set when the citation is a supplement entry's case rather than the primary (epic, stage) entry's.
